title: NEPA Categorical Exclusions — x-graphql Interoperability Template
description: Empty template, derived from https://ce.permitting.innovation.gov/data/exclusions.json, annotated with x-graphql-* extensions so it round-trips into a federated GraphQL subgraph. Use the json-schema-x-graphql converter (Rust `jxql` or Node `@json-schema-x-graphql/core`) on this file to emit SDL.

version.description: Provenance envelope for the entire exclusions catalogue.
Semantic version of the catalogue payload (e.g. 2.0.0).

exclusions.description: Catalogue of categorical exclusions (CATEXs) published by federal agencies.

longUnit.description: Long-form agency unit name (e.g. `Armed Forces Retirement Home`).

origin.description: Human-readable origin list (e.g. `Bureau of Indian Affairs's Categorical Exclusions`).

originUrl.description: Canonical URL to the published CFR / eCFR source list.

context.description: Section heading under which the exclusion is catalogued (e.g. `A.3   CATEXs—Requires No Documentation`).

additionalContext.description: Free-text body of the section heading describing the class of exclusions.

circumstances.description: Extraordinary-circumstances clause that must be considered before applying the exclusion. Often `Not Catalogued`.

exclusion.description: Verbatim exclusion text, including the leading letter/number clause (e.g. `(a) Granting a lease...`).
Look up a single categorical exclusion by its database id.

exclusionByStructuredId.description: Look up a single categorical exclusion by its hierarchical structured id.

exclusions.description: List categorical exclusions, optionally filtered by agency unit.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

exclusionsByOriginUrl.description: List all exclusions published under a given CFR origin URL.
